units: source pixels, [left, top, width, height], origin at top left

artwork.referenceStatus: legacy reference for scene and blank surface only; side rails in this image are superseded by top-decoration-only policy
artwork.surfaceCoverage: One uninterrupted readable pale surface from y790 through y1896, full width, behind year/month, arrows, weekdays, dates and the bottom tab bar. No floor, scene, seam or transition below the calendar surface. App content and tab safety coordinates remain governed by month/weekdays/grid.
retain: scene-specific top decoration above the entire year/month and navigation arrows
continuous readable light surface extending edge to edge behind all app content
prohibit: left vertical rail, border, seam or edge shadow
right vertical rail, border, seam or edge shadow
bottom rim, border, seam, bevel or edge shadow
floor or scenery returning beneath the calendar surface
horizontal seam or material transition beneath the calendar surface
artwork.geometryMeaning: month, weekdays and grid are invisible app overlay and touch coordinates; monthPlate and weekdayPlate are legacy measurement bounds, not printed borders
artwork.styleRule: Design frame and material for each illustration; color-only variants are not sufficient
